m.i.title: megamesh.sh — servèvɛr na yo, ebimelo na yo.
m.i.description: Megamesh ekolonga VPS oyo ezala ya sepele ndenge okoki kofuta mpe ekosala yango VPN personal ya WireGuard ya makasi na web admin mpo na ba appareils na yo. Port misato ezali polele, SSH na clé kaka, fail2ban, TLS automatique, ba upgrades ya poso na poso oyo eyebani santé mpe ezongisaka moko soki esali mabe. Script, AI prompt, to deployer ya one-click. Open source, MIT.
m.i.og_title: megamesh.sh — servèvɛr na yo, ebimelo na yo.
m.i.og_description: VPN personal ya WireGuard oyo ezali makasi na VPS ya 1 GB. Script mpo na sysops, prompt mpo na ba agents AI, mpe web deployer mpo na bato nyonso. Open source, MIT.
i.008: VPN na yo moko · IP moko mpe accès root te mosika
i.009: Servèvɛr na yo,ebimelo na yo.
i.010: Megamesh etongola VPS ya sepele oyo okoki kofuta pona kosala VPN personal ya WireGuard oyo ezali renforcé, mpe ekobakisa web admin mpo na ba appareils na yo. Port misato ezali polele, SSH na clé kaka, TLS automatique, ba upgrades ya poso na poso oyo ezongaka soki ezali mabe. Ya yo, okoki kolanda yango, MIT.
i.015: ~400 MB esalemi kokɔtisa sima ya installation
i.017: eloko te ebombami · eloko te ekotamami na log
i.020: Kofuta tunnel, ozali mokɛlɛ. Kozanga one, kotambwisa yango, ozali opérateur. Ba VPN commerciaux basali mpo na grandeur, te mpo na yo: ebimelo esangisamaka, privacy policy oyo okoki kondima kaka, efelo oyo okomonaka mbala moko te. Bato mingi ya self-hosting ebateli na “WireGuard etelemi” mpe ebimisi porte oyo ebumbi. Megamesh ezali mosala oyo etikali — renforcé par défaut, na VPS oyo etaka moke koleka abonnement.
i.023: Fichier bash moko oyo okoki kotala na minuta zomi, prompt mpo na agent AI na yo, mpe ba configs oyo kotambola na serveur ya référence — nyonso ebimisamaka mobimba, MIT, ebalongwani mbala mibale na ba modèles frontier misato na ba résultats mpe nini esalemaki na yango.
i.025: Idempotent, non-interactive, paramètre nyonso ezali environment variable. Kozongela kotambwisa ekosalela ba choix na yo.
i.026: Pesa yango na agent na yo
i.027: PROMPT.md ezali na objectif, ba règles ya sécurité mpe ba pièges motoba totukaki, kasi mpo agent akoki kobanda epai ya suka.
i.029: IP, mot de passe root, domaine, email. Ebongolaka mot de passe ya root na oyo oponi, einsallaka, mpe epesaka yo login ya admin.
i.036:
Banzela misato ya kokota.
Bino nyonso mosusu ezali efelo.
i.037: Internet ya public ekomaka kaka na ba ports misato. Firewall ezali na default ya DROP, reject te: ba scanners bazwaka nyonso kimia. Na kati, ba containers mibale mpe ba paramètres moke ya host — nyonso ekomami, moko te ezali nse ya mayele.
i.040: tcp/22, udp/51820, tcp/443 mpe eloko mosusu te. Port 80 te, port ya admin te, ba ports ya Docker te oyo ekotelaka. ICMP esengami kaka mpo na ping mpe path-MTU.
i.041: Kuingila na clé kaka, sima fail2ban
i.042: Kuingila na mot de passe etikali nde soki clé ekomi te oyo ekoki kosalama, nsima eyebanaka. Ba essais misato, ba bans ya 24h ebe makasi mpe ekobakisama mbala na mbala kino 30 jours. Ba 76,073 tentatives ebongolaki na mamba moke ya adresses.
i.044: Caddy esukisaka 443 na Let's Encrypt na TLS-ALPN — port 80 ekobongolami te. HSTS, headers strict, mpe header ya Server etongolami.
i.047: Peers, ba QR codes, statistiques, 2FA. Port ya UI ezali te publie; compte admin esalemi automatique liboso 443 ekoma accessible, yango elimbisaka moto moko apesa mbangu mpo atanga wizard liboso na yo.
i.050: topgrade ebonga ba paquets mpe ba images ya container, ebongolaka, eyebisa soki tunnel etelemi mpe admin eyanola — soki ezangi, ebongolaka na ba images oyo esalaki malamu sika. Ebatisami na SHA-256.
i.052: Admin ekoki kokɔta kaka uta na kati
i.053: Commande moko etungisela lokasa ya admin ete eyanola kaka na nzela ya tunnel; bato ya libanda bakoki kozwa 302 oyo okopona na URL oyo oponi. Ba certificats bakobongisama ndenge-dispo.
i.056: Eloko te ya wizard, ba mituna te. Installer etambwisaka mbala nyonso biteni mitano mpe eyebisa te kofungola porte oyo ekoki koteya te ete okoki kokota yango.
i.058: Swap, hostname, na ba modules ya kernel oyo container ekozala na yango bosenga.
i.060: Mibonge mobimba ya système, Docker uta na repo oyo ebatisami, ba mises à jour automatique ya mokolo na mokolo etalelami.
i.062: Firewall liboso, na nsima sshd, fail2ban, sysctl. Kanga soki firewall efungwami naino te.
i.064: wg-easy moko, konto ya admin emonani liboso, na nsima Caddy. Système ezali "fails closed".
i.066: Handshake, ba port, meka lisusu certificate, ba timer. Na nsima epesi yo ba credentials.
i.067: ba konekson ya SSH oyo elongi te na serveur ya reference na mikolo 25 liboso ya Megamesh — na fail2ban “koyamba” mpe ata jail moko te. Na nsima: mwa ba adresi moke banned, mpe kimia.
i.068: Elilingi ya VPS ya ordinaire, oyo ebongisami te<small>ba port ezali koyanola uta na internet</small>
i.069: Box ya WireGuard oyo elandi mibeko<small>wg + ssh + web + docker leaks</small>
i.073: VPN ya moto ye moko ebongolaka nani akoki komona traffic na yo, ezali koyebisa te soki moto moko akoki komona. Depot ezali koyebisa mpenza nini esalemi mpe nini esalemi naino te.
i.075: Mopesi na yo ya VPS amonaka traffic na yo kobima na réseau na bango. Megamesh ekitisa yo toka na Wi-Fi ya café mpe na ISP na yo, kasi ekoki te kolongola yo liboso ya subpoena.
i.076: Ezali te mpo na ba locataire ebele
i.077: Admin moko, ba appareil na yo. wg-easy eyambaka peer mingi, kasi kokiya esalaka ete operator moko nde azali na kondima.
i.079: Ebongolaka mot de passe ya root kasi esetelaka SSH na mot de passe tii moto moko asali install ya key, mpe 2FA mpe mode ya VPN-bobele bozali mpo na yo oyebi kosala. Ba miniti 20 na ba note ya kokiya ebongolaka yango.
i.081: CentOS Stream 9 mpe Ubuntu 24.04 na VPS ya 1 vCPU / 1 GB emonani mpenza ebandeli kino nsuka — ya mibale na nzela ya deployer mpenza. Rocky, Alma mpe Debian ezali kosalela ba nzela ya code wana kasi emekami naino te.
i.084: Ntango ba appareil na yo ezali na tunnel, nionso oyo ozali kosala ezali kobima uta na adresi ya serveur na yo. Wana nde ntina — mpe eloko oyo basusu bakoki kosalela: moninga akoki kotya yo na allow-list, ba box na yo bakoki kotyela yo kondima, rate limit ekoki kosala exception. Mopani abimisaka yango, mpe depot ezali soko ya solo mpo na yango.
i.111: Kobimisa yango ezali mpe ndenge ya komibatela. Lokuta, fake news, kofunda ete “monto abuki app na biso” — likambo nyonso na internet etikaka adresse na log. Tatola ya yo na miso ya bato nyonso, na date ya ebandeli, mpe bilembo nyonso ewuti na esika mosusu ezali, na ndingisa na yo moko ya liboso, yo te. Ezolakisa innocence na yango moko te, kasi epesaka yo makasi: declaration ya bato nyonso, ya date, oyo ekoki kotambolisama mpe esalamaki liboso moto azwa ntina ya kotya tembe.
i.090: Emonisaka server, moto te. Batela authentication na liboso ya eloko nyonso ozo-allow-list — mpe adresse ezalaki na ba tenants mosusu liboso ya date ya ebandeli; eloko moko te ya liboso ya date wana ezali ya author.
i.093: Megamesh ezali version ya moto moko ya ba box megastack.sh, consultancy ya cybersecurity ya mopani, etongamaka mpo na ba client — ebongolami mpe esalemi na agent ya AI na nzela ya SSH, na nsima ebongwanamaki na ba modèle misato mosusu liboso ya kobima na bato.
i.094: Paul Fleury — Mufransi, entrepreneur ya internet oyo azali na Lisbon, azalaki kosala hacking na internet banda suka ya mibu mibale ya 1990.
i.095: Lisolo mobimba — logbook ya deployement ya liboso, ba audit, ba correction — ezali na depot.

m.d.title: Deploy Megamesh na VPS na yo · megamesh.sh
m.d.description: Pesa deployer IP ya VPS na yo, mot de passe ya root, domaine mpe email. Ebongolaka mot de passe ya root na oyo oponi, etyaka Megamesh mpe epesaka yo ba credentials ya admin.
d.008: Makambo minei, na nsima zela. Deployer ekotaka na serveur na yo na nzela ya SSH, ebongolaka mot de passe ya root na oyo oponi, etyela Megamesh mpenza ndenge script ya bato nyonso esalaka, mpe ezongaka na ba identifiants ya admin na yo. Eloko moko te oyo okomi ezali kobombama bipai moko — ezalaka kaka na tab oyo mpe na ba requete oyo ememaka yango.
d.014: VPS ya sika na CentOS Stream 9 to Ubuntu 24.04 (nyonso mibale emekami malamamu, ata na nzela ya lokasa oyo) — Rocky/Alma 9 mpe Debian 12 ekoki kosala kasi emekami naino te. 1 vCPU mpe 1 GB ya RAM ekoki. Osengeli kozala na root na SSH na mot de passe, mpe domaine oyo okoki kobongisa DNS na yango.
d.017: Mot de passe root ya sikawa <small>uta na email to panel ya provider na yo</small>
d.018: Mot de passe root ya sika <small style="font-weight:400;color:var(--faint)">· esengelami</small>
d.019: Oyo provider na yo atindaki elekaki mbala moko na email. Deployer eza kobongola yango na serveur liboso ya kotya eloko moko, mpe ekosalela oyo ya sika kobanda wana. Bomba yango sikawa na gestionnaire ya mot de passe na yo; ekomonana lisusu na nsuka.
d.020: Mot de passe ya sika ya root <small>12–128 mikaba, esika pamba te — to tika mpamba mpo na kobatela oyo ya sikoyo</small>
d.023: Email na yo <small>mpo na ba avis ya certificat kaka</small>
d.024: Clé publique SSH na yo <small>optionnel — soki ozali na yango, ekotya mpe serveur ekosimba makasi</small>
d.025: Tanga liboso ya kofina. Mot de passe root na yo etindami na nzela ya HTTPS na megamesh.sh, mpo na kokengela kotya na serveur na yo na ntango ya installation, mpe ebolongolami na nsima. Refresh nyonso ya status ekotaka lisusu na mot de passe wana. Tobombaka copy te mpe ba logs te. Soki olingi te, script epesaka resultat moko kozanga biso na katikati.
d.028: Ekoti. Talá oyo deployer emoni, mpe oyo eza pene ya kosala.
d.029: Nsosoli ete ezwaka miniti 10–30 mpo na koinstalle, ete mot de passe na ngai ya root elekaka na megamesh.sh muango wana mpe ebombamaka te, mpe ete SSH etikalaka ebatelami na mot de passe kino fungola ekozalisama.
d.033: Ba updates ya ba paquets na mashini ya 1 vCPU ezwaka ntango — miniti 10 kino 30 eza normal. Okoki kotika tab oyo efongwami; installation ekobanda na serveur na yo ata soki okangi yango, mpe kofungola lisusu deployer na ba détails moko ekosimba yango lisusu.
d.042: Makambo misato etikali, nyonso na ngambo na yo. Bomba liboso ba identifiants — emonanaka kaka mbala moko.
d.043: Lakisa domaine na yo na serveur. Na DNS provider na yo (Namecheap, Cloudflare, OVH…), kela A record: host @, valeur . Longola record nyonso ya parking to redirect na kombo moko. Caddy na serveur na yo aza kozela mpe akozwa certificat yemei soki record eyebani — mbala mingi na miniti moke.
d.044: Kota. Fungola (koma https://), kota na ba identifiants admin ya likolo, na nsima fungola authentification à deux facteurs na nse ya compte na yo. Bakisa appareil, scanne QR code, konekta.
d.045: Zwa moninga moko ya informatique asilisa kokanga makambo — miniti makomi mibale na ba notes ya hardening: tya clé SSH mpe longola ba mots de passe, okoki mpe kosala ete lokasa ya admin ezala kaka na VPN. Makambo mosusu nyonso (firewall, fail2ban, ba updates automatique, ba upgrades ya health-checked ya poso na poso) eza kosala deja.
d.046: Ba identifiants na serveur. Copy ya login admin eza na /root/megamesh-admin-credentials na VPS na yo, kotangama kaka na root. Soki obombi nyonso na gestionnaire ya mot de passe, longola yango:
d.047: Nabombaki bango — longola kopie na serveur
j.lang.title: Pona lokota na yo
j.lang.note: Ebobongolami na mashini uta Anglais ya ebandeli, oyo etikalaka référence — ba termes techniques mpe terminal etikalaka na Anglais. Ponona na yo ekobombama na appareil oyo.
j.lang.empty: Eloko te eyokani na lokota wana. Meka kombo na Anglais.
j.d.http_unexpected: Deployer ezongisi eloko moko ya kokamwa (HTTP {code}).
j.d.err_ip: Koma adresse IPv4 ya publike ya server, lokola 203.0.113.10.
j.d.err_pw: Mot de passe ya root ya sikoyo esengeli.
j.d.err_domain: Koma kombo ya domaine mobimba, na ndakisa vpn.example.com.
j.d.err_pubkey: Ligne moko, ebanda na ssh-ed25519 to ssh-rsa.
j.d.mm_installed: Ezalaki e-installami — kozongela kosala ezali mabe te
j.d.ssh_key: Key na SSH ya yo ebotami; connexion na mot de passe ekotikala mpo na ntango okoboma yango
j.d.ssh_nokey: kofungola na mot de passe etikali (sufungola epesameli te)
j.d.note_unsupported: Système oyo ekoki te. Programme d'installation eyebi CentOS Stream / Rocky / Alma 9 mpe Debian / Ubuntu na x86_64. Reinstall na VPS na CentOS Stream 9 to Ubuntu 24.04 uta na panel ya provider na yo mpe kolanda lisusu.
j.d.note_finished: Installation esili mpe ezali kozela yo. Fichier ya ba-identifiants ezali koleka kaka na server — bouton oyo ya na se ezali kotanga yango mpe kolakisa ba-informations ya hand-over, eloko moko eko-installama lisusu te.
j.d.note_running: Installation moko esalemi lisusu na server oyo. Ko-installer ekokangama na yango esika ya kobanda moko mosusu.
j.d.note_besteffort: Système ya ndenge best-effort. Kaka CentOS Stream 9 na Ubuntu 24.04 nde bazwaki vérification tii suka; oyo ezali kopesa nzela ya code oyo ebimi te liboso. Ekozala soki ezali malamu — soki eboyi, log ekoloba wapi.
j.d.note_small: Machine moke. Eza na pasi ya RAM oyo emonanaka pasi moke (<1 GB); programme d'installation ekotonga swap liboso ya kosala mise à jour, oyo ezali nsima ya ndenge esalemaki mpo na yango.
j.d.stopped_err: Ba-lignes ya suka oyo ezali likolo ezali koloba wapi. Bongisa cause (to reinstall VPS) mpe tanga deployer lisusu — programme d'installation ezali idempotent.
j.d.paused: — epesami posa mpo na makambo mingi oyo eboyi.
j.d.changing_pw: Eko-bongola mot de passe ya root…
j.d.log_started: Ekokangani. {pw}Programme d'installation ebandi na server na yo — ekozua release mpe ekosala mise à jour ya ba-paquets…
j.d.log_pw_changed: Mot de passe ya root ebongwanaki.
j.d.pw_changed_note: (Remarque: mot de passe ya root EBONGWANI na oyo ya sika oponaki.)
j.d.h_account_earlier: esengelaki na kosala ya liboso — salela ba-identifiants oyo obombaki tango wana
j.d.h_read_failed: E-installami, kasi kotanga ba-identifiants eboyi: {msg}. Na server: cat /root/megamesh-admin-credentials
